lines.lyric_translation: I believed in myself and threw myself in
But why am I being swept away?
I believed in myself and threw myself in

lines.lyric_hangul: 하지만 왜 아프기만 한 걸까 다 비켜 (사실 난)
lines.lyric_translation: But why does it only hurt? / Everyone, get out of the way (actually, I)
I’m right (I’m scared)
Everyone, just watch (can I do it?)
I’m afraid I won’t be able to keep my word
Why am I changing, more and more?
My inside and outside are changing
But I’m still getting colored
My head hurts
My head hurts
My head hurts
I believed in myself and threw myself in
But why am I being swept away?
I believed in myself and threw myself in
But why does it only hurt?

lines.lyric: A jamkkan na isanghae wae chojeomi heuryeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 아 잠깐 나 이상해 왜 초점이 흐려
lines.lyric_translation: Wait, this is strange, it’s getting blurry

lines.lyric: Wae an kkeutna buranhan soriga gyesok deullyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 안 끝나 불안한 소리가 계속 들려
lines.lyric_translation: Why isn’t this ending? I keep hearing that anxious sound
Even from here

lines.lyric: Paegi neomchyeo da igyeonael geora mideosseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 패기 넘쳐 다 이겨낼 거라 믿었어
lines.lyric_translation: My fighting spirit overflows, I thought I could beat everyone
But not even my rashness can help me endure

lines.lyric: Neomu shwipge bwaseo deo apeun geolkka
lines.lyric_hangul: 너무 쉽게 봐서 더 아픈 걸까
lines.lyric_translation: Maybe it hurts more because I thought it’d be easy
I used to shout out
I wouldn’t change
But why am I changing endlessly
Depending on my surroundings?

lines.lyric: Geunyang tuk geondeurigo jinagan sarami nugunyae ttara
lines.lyric_hangul: 그냥 툭 건드리고 지나간 사람이 누구냐에 따라
lines.lyric_translation: Why do my reactions change
Depending on whoever just passes by?

lines.lyric: Nan tto naega joaya rideum tadeon gogae
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 또 내가 좋아야 리듬 타던 고개
lines.lyric_translation: I used to bop my head if I liked the rhythm
But now I’m doing it cause I’m following someone else
What if my personal tastes change too?
My head hurts
My head hurts
My head hurts
I’m swallowing a pill that gives me baseless confidence / (Gulp gulp)

lines.lyric_hangul: 너무 많이 먹었나 이젠 용기보다는 걱정 (덜덜덜덜)
lines.lyric_translation: Did I take too much? Now I have more worries than courage / (Tremble tremble)

parts.lyric: Neomu mani meogeotna ijen yonggibodaneun geokjeong

lines.lyric_translation: Everything’s changing, from 1 to 10, everything / (More and more)

parts.lyric: Da byeonhaegago isseo ilbuteo shipkkaji modu

lines.lyric_translation: Without my intention, the side effects keep coming
